findings.title: Data quality improved after cleaning
findings.statement: The data quality score increased from 97.1 to 100.0 out of 100 after removing 12 duplicate rows.
findings.recommendation: Maintain the current deduplication pipeline for future data ingestion.

findings.title: Persistent temperature outliers
findings.statement: Despite cleaning, 88 temperature readings are flagged as IQR outliers in the dataset.
findings.recommendation: Investigate sensor hardware for potential calibration issues or environmental interference.

findings.title: Humidity distribution normalized
findings.statement: Humidity skewness was reduced to 0.22, with the maximum value capped at 59.8% after winsorization.
findings.recommendation: Continue monitoring for extreme humidity spikes that may indicate sensor malfunction.

findings.title: Balanced sensor representation
findings.statement: The dataset contains 600 total rows evenly distributed across the sensors after removing duplicates.
findings.recommendation: Perform sensor-specific performance comparisons to identify if one sensor is more prone to errors than others.

narrative.headline: Sensor dataset cleaned to 100.0/100 quality with balanced 600 rows.
narrative.executive_summary: The sensor_readings.csv dataset was successfully cleaned, raising the quality score from 97.1 to 100.0 out of 100 after removing 12 duplicate rows. The final dataset contains 600 total rows evenly distributed across the sensors. Humidity distribution was normalized with a skewness of 0.22 and a maximum value capped at 59.8% after winsorization. However, 88 temperature readings remain flagged as IQR outliers and require attention.
next_steps: Investigate the 88 temperature readings flagged as IQR outliers to determine if they represent hardware errors.
Verify the handling of the -999.0 sensor error value that was imputed for temperature.
Proceed with monitoring room temperature and humidity using the balanced 600 rows across the sensors.
Perform downstream analysis utilizing the standardized snake_case column names.

cleaning.description: Remove rows that are exact copies.
cleaning.rationale: Removing exact duplicate rows improves data quality and reduces redundancy as identified in the table overview.

cleaning.description: Turn missing-value tokens ('N/A', '-', '?', 'null', '') into real missing values.
cleaning.changes: Nothing needed changing: the data already met this rule.
cleaning.rationale: Ensures all missing value representations are standardized before type conversion.

cleaning.description: Convert text numbers to numbers (unparseable -> missing).
cleaning.changes: Converted 'temperature_c' to numbers; changed 132 values in 'temperature_c' (e.g. '23.60' → 23.6; '23.70' → 23.7; '21.80' → 21.8); converted 'humidity_pct' to numbers.
cleaning.rationale: Ensures numeric columns are treated as numbers rather than strings to allow for mathematical operations.

cleaning.description: Fill missing values with a fixed value.
cleaning.changes: Nothing needed changing: the data already met this rule.
cleaning.rationale: Replacing the -999.0 sensor error value with a constant allows for proper handling of missing data without skewing statistical calculations.

cleaning.description: Add a <column>_outlier flag using the 1.5 x IQR rule.
cleaning.changes: Marked 88 rows in a new 'temperature_c_outlier' column.
cleaning.rationale: Flagging temperature outliers using the 1.5 x IQR rule preserves data points for analysis while identifying potential sensor inconsistencies.

cleaning.description: Cap extreme values at the given quantiles.
cleaning.rationale: Capping humidity values at the 99th percentile addresses readings exceeding 100% while maintaining the distribution of valid data.

cleaning.description: Mark identifier columns so they're left out of statistics.
cleaning.changes: Nothing needed changing: the data already met this rule.
cleaning.rationale: Designating identifier columns ensures they are excluded from statistical analysis and outlier detection.

cleaning.description: Rename columns to snake_case. Put this last: later steps would need the new names.
cleaning.changes: Nothing needed changing: the data already met this rule.
cleaning.rationale: Standardizing column names to snake_case ensures consistency for downstream analysis.
